title: Simultaneous derived reduction computed on regular complexes
statement: For a prime ell and any scheme W, let A be the category of integral abelian sheaves on the pro-etale site, and let L be extension to discrete constant Z_ell modules as in [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface]. Given the displayed derived-category universe choices, there exist simultaneous derived reductions D of L and I of the identity on A. For every complex P on which every positive power of ell acts monomorphically in each degree, both universal counits D.epsilon(P) and I.epsilon(P) are isomorphisms.

source.place: Proof step 3: construction of the strict simultaneous derived reduction, and step 5: computation on the supported integral source

proof.text: Define the level functors as cokernels of ell^(n+1) times the identity. Cokernel descent gives natural maps and quotient transitions; their naturality defines one additive strict tower functor. Its quotient maps satisfy all ordinary-presentation laws. This is a real construction, without choosing an unproved existential witness.

For an exact additive L, the multiplication/quotient short complexes are short exact on complexes with monic positive-power multiplication. The homology long exact sequences show that reduction preserves quasi-isomorphisms between these complexes. Evaluation detects quasi-isomorphisms of strict systems.

Flat sheaves have monic nonzero-integer multiplication: tensor the monomorphism on the constant integer unit and use the tensor unitor. The flat-term K-flat resolution of [lem-pc-source-module-kflat-resolution] therefore resolves every complex by the preceding class. The flatness of Z_ell over Z follows from torsion-freeness over the PID Z, so the sheafified extension L is exact.

Apply [lem-pur-left-derived-from-kflat-class] to the homotopy functor of the additive strict reduction. Descend its universal and pointwise left-derived properties through the full essentially surjective homotopy quotient. The same resolving-class theorem computes its counit on every regular complex. Apply this construction to L and to the identity.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_diagonalDerivedReduction (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W)] :
    ∃ (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W))
      (I : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (𝟭 (DiagonalAb W))),
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (DiagonalAb W) ℤ,
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), Mono (ℓ ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 (P.X i))) →
          IsIso (D.ε.app P)) ∧
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (DiagonalAb W) ℤ,
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), Mono (ℓ ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 (P.X i))) →
          IsIso (I.ε.app P))
